overview.value: Dragon Factory has become a staple of All you can eat sushi, all you can eat kbbq and all you can hot pot places all across the Las Vegas. We bring new innovative experiences and combine them with the traditional styles of foods you love.

foundingStory.value: Dragon Factory Company founded in 2013 has evolved from a cozy mom and pop shop named Sakana into a culinary powerhouse. With a foundation rooted in creativity and innovation, expanding our concept into a diverse portfolio of restaurants. Our journey from a single restaurant to a flourishing enterprise showcases our passion for food and unwavering commitment to reinventing the dining landscape.

pages.title: DRAGON FACTORY LAS VEGAS | ALL YOU CAN EAT KBBQ | ALL YOU CAN EAT SUSHI | ALL YOU CAN EAT HOT POT
pages.metaDescription: Dragon Factory has become a staple of All you can eat sushi, all you can eat kbbq and all you can hot pot places all across the Las Vegas. We bring new innovative experiences and combine them with the traditional styles of foods you love.

pages.title: ALL YOU CAN EAT KBBQ | DRAGON FACTORY
pages.metaDescription: ragon Factory's journey began with Hwaro 1, which underwent renovations and menu innovations over the years, now offering a fusion of BBQ and sushi delights. As Hwaro 1 expanded, Hwaro 2 emerged, specializing in traditional Korean BBQ. Today, Kogi and Captain 6 provide a diverse array of Korean BBQ experiences, including all-you-can-eat hot pot, classic Korean BBQ, and mouthwatering seafood boils.

pages.title: ALL YOU CAN EAT SUSHI | DRAGON FACTORY
pages.metaDescription: Dragon Factory originated with its flagship store, Sakana, and has since bloomed into a collection of all-you-can-eat sushi restaurants including Sushi Neko, Sushi Supremo, Umami, and Mr. Shota, offering a diverse range of sushi dining experiences.

pages.title: ALL YOU CAN EAT HOTPOT | DRAGON FACTORY
pages.metaDescription: At Nabe, we specialize in the ultimate all-you-can-eat experience featuring hot pot and sushi, complemented by a delectable selection of appetizers. Dive into a customizable feast with various broth options to elevate your dining adventure and savor the best of both worlds in one unforgettable meal.

pages.title: APPLY NOW | DRAGON FACTORY
pages.metaDescription: Join us at Dragon Factory, where all generations are welcome to apply and work together! Simply fill out the form below, and we'll reach out to you promptly. Embrace diversity and be a part of our team today!
